content:
import afield.lang.solidsl.*
import afield.lang.solidsl.study.*
import kotlin.math.*

// The swollen outer chamber, with a small off-centre crown like a growing shell.
val chamber = sphere(1.0).sized(1.18, 0.98, 1.38).at(0.0, 0.0, 3.42)
val crown = sphere(0.54).sized(1.0, 0.94, 1.12).at(0.33, 0.0, 4.36)
val envelope = smoothUnion(chamber, crown, 0.32)

// A thin cast wall, open below for access to the light.
val wall = envelope.shelled(0.065)
val mouth = cylinder(0.9, 0.44).at(0.0, 0.0, 2.04)

// Growing, slanted oval apertures follow one continuous spiral up the chamber.
val apertures = unionOf(List(19) { i ->
    val u = i / 18.0
    val latitude = (-61.0 + 124.0 * u) * PI / 180.0
    val angle = 594.0 * u + 15.0
    val theta = angle * PI / 180.0
    val opening = 0.16 + 0.06 * sin(PI * u)
    sphere(1.0).sized(0.65, opening * 1.05, opening * 1.40)
        .turned(28.0, 0.0, angle)
        .at(1.18 * cos(latitude) * cos(theta),
            0.98 * cos(latitude) * sin(theta),
            3.42 + 1.38 * sin(latitude))
})
val shade = wall - mouth - apertures

// A low, heavy foot with a soft rolled edge and a flared neck.
val foot = cylinder(0.20, 0.77, 0.70).rounded(0.07).at(0.0, 0.0, 0.17)
val root = cylinder(0.43, 0.50, 0.12).rounded(0.05).at(0.0, 0.0, 0.42)
val pedestal = smoothUnion(foot, root, 0.14)

// The fine stem grows into the lower wall at the back of the open mouth.
val stem = cylinder(2.05, 0.105, 0.085).at(0.0, 0.36, 1.45)
val neck = sphere(0.22).sized(1.0, 1.0, 1.6).at(0.0, 0.43, 2.25)
val support = smoothUnion(smoothUnion(pedestal, stem, 0.16), neck, 0.12)
val lamp = smoothUnion(support, shade, 0.085)

// Warm, lightly mottled cast bronze: colour variation, not machined surface grooves.
lamp.shaded("""
vec3 shade(vec3 p, vec3 n, vec3 rd, float t) {
    vec3 l = normalize(vec3(-0.5, -0.7, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(dot(n, l), 0.0);
    float grain = sin(p.x*73.0 + sin(p.z*57.0))*sin(p.y*91.0 + p.z*39.0);
    vec3 bronze = vec3(0.40, 0.225, 0.105) * (1.0 + 0.045*grain);
    float ao = occlusion(p, n);
    float spec = pow(max(dot(n, normalize(l-rd)), 0.0), 36.0);
    return bronze*(0.26 + 0.85*diffuse)*ao + vec3(0.55,0.36,0.17)*spec*0.45;
}
""", background = 0x20262B)

{"description":"Replace the egg with a genuinely growing, hollow logarithmic coil with an open terminal mouth","expectedRevision":"r3-bd1337c9db11","expectedSourceHash":"bd1337c9db11a19e345ce7c0f305d3ce3beb4f4c78b6bf5b855970e8e17f556e","previewSeconds":[0,3,6],"source":"import afield.lang.solidsl.*
import afield.lang.solidsl.study.*
import kotlin.math.*

// A logarithmic centreline: both its radius and its chamber grow as it winds.
val sweep = 2.60 * PI
val growth = 0.28
val coreRadius = 0.15
val wallHalf = 0.045
val samples = 64
val coilParts = List(samples) { i ->
    val t = sweep * i / (samples - 1.0)
    val r = coreRadius * exp(growth * t)
    val a = t - sweep
    val chamberRadius = 0.05 + 0.42 * r
    sphere(chamberRadius).at(r * cos(a), r * sin(a), 0.0)
}
// Blend overlapping round sections, then offset that same field on both sides.
// Shelled(half) gives a nominal full wall of 0.09 throughout the growing chamber.
val envelope = coilParts.reduce { a, b -> smoothUnion(a, b, 0.075) }
val wall = envelope.shelled(wallHalf)

// Slice off the terminal cap perpendicular to the growth line: a real open mouth.
val endRadius = coreRadius * exp(growth * sweep)
val tangentAngle = atan2(1.0, growth)
val mouth = cuboid(3.0, 3.0, 3.0)
    .turned(0.0, 0.0, tangentAngle * 180.0 / PI)
    .at(endRadius + cos(tangentAngle) * 1.43, sin(tangentAngle) * 1.43, 0.0)

// Apertures ride the upper face of the actual coil, growing toward its mouth.
val apertures = unionOf(List(15) { i ->
    val u = i / 14.0
    val t = 0.6 + (sweep - 1.05) * u
    val r = coreRadius * exp(growth * t)
    val a = t - sweep
    val chamberRadius = 0.05 + 0.42 * r
    val holeRadius = 0.030 + 0.135 * u
    sphere(1.0).sized(holeRadius * 1.35, holeRadius, 0.20)
        .turned(0.0, 0.0, (a + tangentAngle) * 180.0 / PI)
        .at(r * cos(a), r * sin(a), chamberRadius)
})
val localShade = wall - mouth - apertures
// Tilt the coiling plane so it can be read bot...
